title: MCC Players
description: Map of player names to optional metadata collected for each player.

ign.description: The name of their Minecraft player character

uuid.description: The player's Minecraft UUID, or "unresolvable" if the player's IGN could not be resolved to a UUID.

aliases.description: A list of alternate names that will be used to normalize the player

birthday.description: Player's date of birth in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.

island.description: MCC Island stats to use as a prior in the case of missing or incomplete data.

lastupdate.description: The last time this players MCC Island stats were updated as an ISO 8601 formatted date

games.description: The number of times the player has played this game.

wins.description: The number of times the player has won this game.
